usedFor: Shippo holds orders and shipping labels, and HubSpot records each one as a deal through “Create Deal”.

bestTemplate.name: “New Order” in Shippo, then “Create Deal” in HubSpot
bestTemplate.why: A new order in the shipping tool is a sale in motion, and the action opens the deal for it.

watchOut: “Update Deal” in HubSpot needs the deal ID, so keep the ID from an earlier “Create Deal” step.
